title: Generic finite local constancy of module subsheaves
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $\Lambda$ a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and $\varphi:F\to G$ a monomorphism of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Assume $G$ is constructible [def-constructible-constructible]. There exists an open subset $U\subseteq X$ dense in $X$ such that the restriction of $F$ to $U$ is finite locally constant [def-constructible-finite-locally-constant], where finite means finitely generated module stalks. No constructibility conclusion is asserted on $X\setminus U$.

source.place: Tag 09BH, Proposition 59.74.1 (3), proof of (3), generic-neighbourhood argument

proof.text: Apply IsConstructibleSheaf.exists_dense_open to G, obtaining a dense open U on which G is finite locally constant. Restrict the monomorphism to U. This open subscheme is Noetherian: its space is compact because X is topologically Noetherian, and it is locally Noetherian by open restriction.

At every geometric point of U, the stalk map of the restricted monomorphism is injective. Its target is finitely generated, so the source stalk is finitely generated over the Noetherian coefficient ring. This establishes IsFiniteSheaf for the restriction of F to U directly in Lean, using AB5OfSize_shrink and FinitelyGeneratedOfMono. For each component generic point of U, apply the local-neighbourhood lemma to obtain an open V_eta where F is locally constant. Finiteness pulls back to V_eta, making each restriction finite locally constant.

Let W be the union of the V_eta inside U. Every generic point lies in W, so W is dense, by genericPoints.closure for the sober underlying space of a scheme. Use Opens.iSupOpenCover and IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf.of_openCover to glue the finite locally constant restrictions on W; the pullbacks are identified by upperStarComp and homOfLE_ι. The composite open immersion W -> U -> X has dense range, by DenseRange.comp. Its open image is the desired open of X: upperStarComp and invariance under equal immersion images identify the restriction there with the restriction to W. The empty-index cover handles the empty scheme.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09BH (3); C1 Lean reduction: generic constancy of G, stalk finiteness, local generic neighbourhoods, and dense-union gluing

theorem exists_dense_open_of_mono_noetherian
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] {Λ : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing Λ]
    [IsNoetherianRing Λ]
    {F G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)}
    (φ : F ⟶ G) [Mono φ] [IsConstructibleSheaf G] :
    ∃ U : X.Opens, Dense (U : Set X) ∧
      IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) U.ι).obj F)
